method_summary.binary: Exact McNemar test on paired binary outcomes.
method_summary.conditional_binary: Exact McNemar test after filtering to pairs where both orders are executable.
method_summary.numeric: Paired t-test and paired sign-flip permutation test.
method_summary.problem_level: Runs are averaged per problem before a paired sign-flip permutation test; bootstrap CI resamples problems.
method_summary.multiple_comparisons: Holm adjustment across canonical-vs-order comparisons and extra comparisons within each model/metric/test family.

metric_definitions.reachability: Goal reached under strict VAL validation.
metric_definitions.executability: Plan executed under strict VAL validation.
metric_definitions.non_executable_failure: Strict validation failed before executable completion.
metric_definitions.conditional_reachability: Goal reached among pairs where both orders produced executable plans.
metric_definitions.plan_length: Strict VAL plan length; only available when goal is reached.
metric_definitions.optimality_ratio: Validated cost divided by reference cost; only available when goal is reached.
metric_definitions.first_failure_step: First failed execution step; only available for state execution errors.
metric_definitions.completion_tokens: Completion tokens reported or normalized from provider payload.
metric_definitions.raw_completion_tokens: Raw answer-token component of completion tokens.
metric_definitions.total_tokens: Total tokens reported or normalized from provider payload.
